---
title: "Update Prices and Stock"
description: "Change the price and available stock for an offer you already sell."
---

Price and stock live on the offer, not the product. You change them from an offer's detail page in the Vendor Portal, where each variant has its own price and stocked quantity.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the offers list">
    Go to **Products**, then **Offers** in the sidebar. Select the offer whose price or stock you want to change.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/update-prices-and-stock/step-1.png" alt="Open the offers list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the offer">
    Selecting a row opens the offer's detail page.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Update prices and stock">
    The detail page shows one row per variant. Use **Edit prices** to set a price for each of your store currencies, and **Edit stock** to set the stocked quantity at each of your locations. An offer only appears on the storefront once a variant has both a price and stock, so keep both current.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/update-prices-and-stock/step-3.png" alt="Update prices and stock" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
</Steps>
